data.name: Masudi
data.gender_notes: Masudi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the word ‘Masda’ which means wisdom and knowledge. The name Masudi carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Masudi usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Masudi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masudi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مَسْعُودِي
in_arabic.meaning: هو اسم يُشير إلى الشخص الذي يُعتبر مسعوفاً
in_arabic.long_meaning: هو اسم يُشير إلى الشخص الذي يُعتبر مسعوفاً أو مؤمناً بقيادة النبي محمد، ويُستخدم هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفتح: \"وَلَقَدْ أَعْطَينَا مَسْعُودِيَ الْبَطْنَ\" (الفتح: 9). ويُعتبر هذا الاسم من أهم الأسماء في الإسلام، حيث يُشير إلى الشخص الذي يُعتبر مسعوفاً وذو إيمان قوي.

in_urdu.name: مسعودی
in_urdu.meaning: یہ نام وہ شخص کا ہوتا ہے جو مؤمن ہوتا ہے اور پیغمبر محمد صل اللہ علیہ وسلم کی قیادت پر امانت دار ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام وہ شخص کا ہوتا ہے جو مؤمن ہوتا ہے اور پیغمبر محمد صل اللہ علیہ وسلم کی قیادت پر امانت دار ہوتا ہے، یہ نام قرآن کریم میں سورة الفتح میں آیا ہے، "اور ہم نے مسعودی کو انعام دیا ہے" (الفتح: 9)۔ یہ نام بہت اہم ہے اور یہ نام ایمان کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मसूदी
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम वह व्यक्ति का होता है जो ईमानदार होता है और पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम की नेतृत्व पर भरोसेमंद होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम वह व्यक्ति का होता है जो ईमानदार होता है और पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम की नेतृत्व पर भरोसेमंद होता है, यह नाम कुरआन में सूरह अल-फतह में आया है, \"और हमने मसूदी को इनाम दिया\" (अल-फतह: 9)। यह नाम बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और यह ईमान का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: مسعودی
in_pashto.meaning: هغه وخت ووچې د پیغمبر محمد صل الله علیہ وسلم په لور پوه او امانتدار وو
in_pashto.long_meaning: هغه وخت ووچې د پیغمبر محمد صل الله علیہ وسلم په لور پوه او امانتدار وو، دا نوم کورآن کریم کې سوره الفتح کې راغلی دی، \"او ډېرې مساعدۍ او مدد په دې کې وکړه\" (الفتح: 9)۔ دا نوم له اسلامي تاریخ څخه راغلی دی او په افغانستان کې په ټولو مسلمو کې په پوه کېږي.

in_english.name: Masudi
in_english.meaning: A name given to a person who is a follower of the Islamic faith and has strong faith in the leadership of the Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: A name given to a person who is a follower of the Islamic faith and has strong faith in the leadership of the Prophet Muhammad, this name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Fath: \"And We granted Masudi (the believers) a great victory\" (Al-Fath: 9). This name is one of the most important names in Islam and is widely used among Muslims around the world.

Furthermore, the name Masudi reflects the Islamic values of education and knowledge, which are considered essential in the pursuit of an enlightened life.

historical_references.reference: Al-Masudi's works include the 'Muruj Al-Dhahab wa Ma'adin Al-Jawahir' and 'The Land between the Two Rivers'. He is considered one of the earliest Arab geographers and historians, active during the Abbasid Caliphate in the 9th and 10th centuries.
historical_references.context: Early Arab geographer and historian during the Abbasid Caliphate

historical_references.reference: Al-Masudi was born in Mesopotamia, and traveled extensively in the Islamic world. His works provide detailed descriptions of the geography, peoples, and cultures of the Islamic world, as well as historical information.
historical_references.context: Traveled extensively in the Islamic world, providing detailed descriptions and historical information

modern_usage.modern_context:
The name 'Masudi' is commonly associated with the renowned 9th-10th century Persian scholar and geographer, Ibn Hawqal al-Masudi. In the modern context, the name 'Masudi' has gained renewed interest in various academic fields, particularly in Islamic history, academic research, and digital humanities. Researchers often refer to Ibn Hawqal al-Masudi's works, such as 'Ahsan at-Taqasim fi Ma'rifat al-Aqalim' (The Best Divisions for Knowing the Regions), to gain insights into the history and geography of the Islamic world during the Middle Ages. 

Platforms like Academia.edu, JSTOR, and Project Mamma have become essential resources for scholars and researchers to access and share their work on Ibn Hawqal al-Masudi and related topics. Academia.edu allows researchers to create profiles, upload and share their papers, and connect with other scholars in their field. JSTOR is a digital library that provides access to academic journals, books, and primary sources, including many works by and about Ibn Hawqal al-Masudi. Project Mamma is a digital humanities project dedicated to the study of medieval Islamic manuscripts, including some of Ibn Hawqal al-Masudi's works. These platforms enable scholars to collaborate, share research, and advance knowledge of Ibn Hawqal al-Masudi and the Islamic world of the Middle Ages.
